pluginImplementations.name: AlephOaiCatalogAdapter
pluginImplementations.description: Connects to live MZK Aleph.

pluginImplementations.name: KrameriusRegistry
pluginImplementations.description: Asks a Kramerius instance whether a record is already published.

pluginImplementations.name: RdczRegistry
pluginImplementations.description: Reports what other libraries plan and hold in the national digitization registry.

pluginImplementations.name: PageCountPredictor
pluginImplementations.description: Estimates an extent from material type, year and format when no catalogue extent exists.

pluginImplementations.name: PeriodicalGaps
pluginImplementations.description: Finds missing volumes of periodicals partly digitized in Kramerius.

pluginImplementations.name: DnntoFromSdnnt
pluginImplementations.description: Finds documents with DNNTO in SDNNT that no library has digitized.

pluginImplementations.name: MarcComparator
pluginImplementations.description: Validates a record against SKC and ČNB through the MARC comparator application.

pluginImplementations.name: FieldsCompleteness
pluginImplementations.description: Checks required fields for each issuance type.

pluginImplementations.name: ForbiddenByRecordValue
pluginImplementations.description: Forbids digitizing when a field or subfield holds a given value.

pluginImplementations.name: JqCustody
pluginImplementations.description: Evaluates one jq condition over the proposal as JSON; when it holds, the proposal is in the custody the instance picks.

pluginImplementations.name: BarcodeReader
pluginImplementations.description: Reads EAN-13 (ISBN), ISSN and library barcodes from the device camera. A hardware scanner needs no plugin — it types like a keyboard.

pluginImplementations.name: CoverRecognition
pluginImplementations.description: Reads a photo of a cover, title page or catalog card — identifiers, and the text itself (title, author, place, year, shelf mark) — and matches it to catalog records.

pluginImplementations.name: PriorityThenMix
pluginImplementations.description: Fills each category to its share, highest priority first, then the oldest ask. Deterministic.

pluginImplementations.name: ShelfAdvisor
pluginImplementations.description: A model reads the pool and proposes a list, giving its own reason for every pick. Not deterministic.

pluginImplementations.name: OidcIdentity
pluginImplementations.description: Logs in through an OpenID Connect provider — Keycloak, or any other.

pluginImplementations.name: LocalAccounts
pluginImplementations.description: Usernames and passwords kept by VERA — for people with no institutional account.

pluginImplementations.name: KrameriusLink
pluginImplementations.description: Reads a Kramerius PID or viewer address and gives the item's canonical link there.

pluginImplementations.name: Kramerius72XPublicationDetector
pluginImplementations.description: Detects publications from Kramerius 72X fields.

pluginImplementations.name: Pattern
pluginImplementations.description: Recognises one identifier type by a regular expression after normalising the value, with an optional checksum, and names the type in each language.

pluginImplementations.name: MailtoMessage
pluginImplementations.description: Opens the person's mail client with the recipients, subject and a link back filled in.

pluginImplementations.name: SlackMessage
pluginImplementations.description: Opens a Slack DM, or a group DM, with the recipients — a deep link with the text pre-filled.

pluginImplementations.name: SmtpMailer
pluginImplementations.description: Sends mail through an SMTP server.

pluginImplementations.name: GmailAccountMailer
pluginImplementations.description: Sends mail through the Gmail API with a send-only OAuth2 client.

pluginImplementations.name: SlackNotifier
pluginImplementations.description: Posts to a Slack channel as a bot.

pluginImplementations.name: HttpWebhook
pluginImplementations.description: POSTs the event as JSON, signed with a shared secret.

pluginImplementations.name: SftpDrop
pluginImplementations.description: Writes a file to an SFTP folder.

pluginImplementations.name: PlaceOfPublication
pluginImplementations.description: Suggests the regional line for a periodical published in a Moravian place.

pluginImplementations.name: MaterialType
pluginImplementations.description: Suggests a leaf by material type: periodicals and maps; a monograph needs its period.

pluginImplementations.name: EntryLink
pluginImplementations.description: Lets an outside portal link into Propose with an item filled in (ACT-entry-link).

pluginImplementations.name: SlackBotMessage
pluginImplementations.description: Posts a direct message to reachable Slack recipients.

pluginImplementations.name: ShelfMarkRecognition
pluginImplementations.description: Recognises shelf marks on spines.

pluginImplementations.name: CatalogCardRecognition
pluginImplementations.description: Recognises catalog cards.

pluginImplementations.name: DnntoFromCatalog
pluginImplementations.description: Finds MZK records that could get the DNNTO licence if digitized.

pluginImplementations.name: SftpFile
pluginImplementations.description: Finds new files in an SFTP directory (CSV or TXT).

pluginImplementations.name: GoogleSheet
pluginImplementations.description: Finds new rows of a Google Sheet through a service account.

pluginImplementations.name: XmlDumpCatalogAdapter
pluginImplementations.description: Reads a downloaded catalog dump refreshed on schedule; the reading's date is the dump's.

pluginImplementations.name: MarcExtentPageCount
pluginImplementations.description: Parses page count from 300 $a.

pluginImplementations.name: SiblingVolumePageCount
pluginImplementations.description: Estimates periodical page count as the median of the title's volumes already digitized.

pluginImplementations.name: ShelfMarkToSize
pluginImplementations.description: Derives size from the shelf mark's prefix.

pluginImplementations.name: JqProperty
pluginImplementations.description: Reads any property by a jq expression over the record.
